import datetime

report = api.portal_reports.latest_published()
has_report = bool(report)

report_id = ""
month_label = ""
month_yyyy_mm = ""
past_events = []
upcoming_events = []
gallery_paths = []
template_path = ""
font_regular_path = ""
font_bold_path = ""
font_semibold_path = ""
font_lato_path = ""
metrics = []

if report:
    report_id = report.get("id") or ""

    report_month = report.get("reportMonth") or ""
    try:
        dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(report_month).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except Exception:
        dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
    month_label = dt.strftime("%B %Y")
    month_yyyy_mm = dt.strftime("%Y-%m")

    def _paragraphs(body):
        """Reconstruct logical bullet items from a body that stores each
        wrapped display line as its own '\n'-separated line: a line starting
        with an uppercase word begins a new item, a lowercase-initial line is
        a wrap-continuation of the previous item."""
        text = body or ""
        lines = [ln for ln in text.split("\n") if ln.strip()]
        paras = []
        current = ""
        for line in lines:
            first_word = line.split(" ", 1)[0] if line else ""
            is_continuation = bool(current) and first_word[:1].islower()
            if is_continuation:
                current = current + " " + line
            else:
                if current:
                    paras.append(current.strip())
                current = line
        if current:
            paras.append(current.strip())
        return paras

    for e in (report.get("events") or []):
        section = e.get("section") or ""
        heading = e.get("heading") or ""
        paras = _paragraphs(e.get("body") or "")
        if section == "past_month":
            past_events.append({"heading": heading, "body": paras})
        elif section == "upcoming":
            items = []
            for p in paras:
                if ":" in p:
                    lead, _, rest = p.partition(":")
                    items.append([lead.strip(), rest.strip()])
                else:
                    items.append([p.strip(), ""])
            upcoming_events.append({"heading": heading, "items": items})

    for gpath in (report.get("galleryPaths") or [])[:4]:
        try:
            local_path = api.portal_reports.read_image(path=gpath)
            if local_path:
                gallery_paths.append(local_path)
        except Exception:
            pass

    metrics = api.portal_reports.metrics(report_id=report_id) or []

    template_path = api.files.get(file="Automations/template.pdf")
    font_regular_path = api.files.get(file="Automations/Rubik-Regular.ttf")
    font_bold_path = api.files.get(file="Automations/Rubik-Bold.ttf")
    font_semibold_path = api.files.get(file="Automations/Rubik-SemiBold.ttf")
    font_lato_path = api.files.get(file="Automations/Lato-Regular.ttf")

from fpdf import FPDF
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

W, H = 595.5, 842.25
ORANGE = (254, 96, 0)
NAVY = (10, 36, 63)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
BLACK = (0, 0, 0)
GRAY = (239, 239, 239)


def _s(t):
    t = t or ""
    for a, b in [
        ("—", "-"), ("–", "-"), ("‘", "'"), ("’", "'"),
        ("“", '"'), ("”", '"'), ("…", "..."),
    ]:
        t = t.replace(a, b)
    return t


def _font_setup(pdf, regular, bold, semibold, lato):
    pdf.add_font("Rubik", "", regular)
    pdf.add_font("Rubik", "B", bold)
    pdf.add_font("RubikSemi", "", semibold)
    pdf.add_font("Lato", "", lato)


def _cover(pdf, x0, y0, x1, y1, rgb):
    pdf.set_fill_color(*rgb)
    pdf.rect(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0, style="F")


def _ctext(pdf, cx, baseline, text, font, style, size, rgb):
    pdf.set_font(font, style, size)
    pdf.set_text_color(*rgb)
    w = pdf.get_string_width(text)
    pdf.text(cx - w / 2, baseline, text)


def _wrapped(pdf, x, y, width, lines, font, style, size, rgb, leading, bullet="• ", markdown=False):
    pdf.set_font(font, style, size)
    pdf.set_text_color(*rgb)
    for para in lines:
        pdf.set_xy(x, y)
        pdf.multi_cell(width, leading, bullet + para, align="L", markdown=markdown,
                        new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
        y = pdf.get_y() + 2.5
    return y


def _build_overlay(data, fonts):
    pdf = FPDF(unit="pt", format=(W, H))
    _font_setup(pdf, *fonts)

    # ===================== PAGE 1 =====================
    pdf.add_page()
    _cover(pdf, 451, 40, 566, 59, NAVY)
    pdf.set_font("Lato", "", 9)
    pdf.set_text_color(*WHITE)
    w = pdf.get_string_width(data["date_label"])
    pdf.text(562 - w, 56.5, data["date_label"])

    # metric circles
    # The template's own artwork has placeholder numbers baked into these
    # circles ("19 DAYS", "76%", …) — the zone must always be covered even
    # when this portal has no value yet (null leave_taken_days renders as a
    # blank circle, never the template's leftover placeholder digits).
    _cover(pdf, 165, 188, 210, 233, ORANGE)
    if data["leave"] is not None:
        _ctext(pdf, 187.5, 214, data["leave"], "Rubik", "", 21, WHITE)
    _ctext(pdf, 187.5, 227, "DAYS", "Rubik", "", 9, WHITE)
    _cover(pdf, 277, 190, 324, 223, ORANGE)
    if data["office"] is not None:
        _ctext(pdf, 300.6, 218, data["office"], "Rubik", "", 21, WHITE)
    pdf.set_fill_color(239, 233, 232)
    pdf.ellipse(409 - 21, 208 - 21, 42, 42, style="F")
    if data["attend"] is not None:
        _ctext(pdf, 409, 217, data["attend"], "Rubik", "", 17, BLACK)

    # past-month events (cover gray band, redraw up to 2 columns)
    _cover(pdf, 38, 568, 560, 688, GRAY)
    cols = [(42, 200), (256, 205)]
    for i, ev in enumerate(data["past"][:2]):
        cx, cw = cols[i]
        pdf.set_font("Rubik", "B", 11)
        pdf.set_text_color(*NAVY)
        pdf.text(cx, 588, ev["heading"])
        _wrapped(pdf, cx, 614, cw, ev["body"], "Rubik", "", 9, NAVY, 11.5)

    # 4 gallery photos
    rects = [(39.9, 695.2, 182.5, 786.0), (190.8, 696.3, 306.3, 786.3),
             (313.7, 696.6, 435.2, 785.9), (442.9, 696.6, 557.7, 785.9)]
    for path, (x0, y0, x1, y1) in zip(data["photos"], rects):
        try:
            pdf.image(path, x=x0, y=y0, w=x1 - x0, h=y1 - y0)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # ===================== PAGE 2 =====================
    pdf.add_page()
    _cover(pdf, 451, 40, 566, 59, NAVY)
    pdf.set_font("Lato", "", 9)
    pdf.set_text_color(*WHITE)
    w = pdf.get_string_width(data["date_label"])
    pdf.text(562 - w, 56.5, data["date_label"])

    _cover(pdf, 40, 120, 366, 338, WHITE)
    gy = 129
    for gi, grp in enumerate(data["upcoming"][:2]):
        pdf.set_font("RubikSemi", "", 10)
        pdf.set_text_color(*ORANGE)
        pdf.text(44, gy + 10, grp["category"])
        y = gy + 20
        paras = []
        for lead, body in grp["items"]:
            clean_lead = lead.rstrip(":")
            clean_body = body.lstrip(": ")
            paras.append("**" + clean_lead + ":** " + clean_body)
        y = _wrapped(pdf, 61, y, 295, paras, "Rubik", "", 10, NAVY, 11.8, markdown=True)
        gy = max(241, y + 10) if gi == 0 else y

    return pdf


month_label = params["month_label"]
leave_taken_days = params.get("leave_taken_days")
office_days_pct = params.get("office_days_pct")
attendance_pct = params.get("attendance_pct")
past_events = params["past_events"] or []
upcoming_events = params["upcoming_events"] or []
gallery_paths = params["gallery_paths"] or []
template_path = params["template_path"]
font_regular_path = params["font_regular_path"]
font_bold_path = params["font_bold_path"]
font_semibold_path = params["font_semibold_path"]
font_lato_path = params["font_lato_path"]
portal_id = params["portal_id"]
month_yyyy_mm = params["month_yyyy_mm"]

data = {
    "date_label": _s("Reporting Date: " + month_label),
    "leave": (("%.0f" % leave_taken_days) if leave_taken_days is not None else None),
    "office": (("%.0f%%" % office_days_pct) if office_days_pct is not None else None),
    "attend": (("%.0f%%" % attendance_pct) if attendance_pct is not None else None),
    "past": [
        {"heading": _s(ev.get("heading") or ""), "body": [_s(b) for b in (ev.get("body") or [])]}
        for ev in past_events
    ],
    "upcoming": [
        {
            "category": _s(ev.get("heading") or ""),
            "items": [[_s(lead), _s(body)] for lead, body in (ev.get("items") or [])],
        }
        for ev in upcoming_events
    ],
    "photos": gallery_paths,
}

overlay = _build_overlay(data, (font_regular_path, font_bold_path, font_semibold_path, font_lato_path))
overlay_path = api.files.scratch_path("overlay-" + portal_id + ".pdf")
overlay.output(overlay_path)

tpl_reader = PdfReader(template_path)
overlay_reader = PdfReader(overlay_path)
writer = PdfWriter()
page_count = min(len(tpl_reader.pages), len(overlay_reader.pages), 2)
for i in range(page_count):
    page = tpl_reader.pages[i]
    page.merge_page(overlay_reader.pages[i])
    writer.add_page(page)

merged_path = api.files.scratch_path("report-" + portal_id + ".pdf")
with open(merged_path, "wb") as fh:
    writer.write(fh)

saved_path = "Monthly Reports/" + month_yyyy_mm + ".pdf"
api.files.put(file=saved_path, scratch_file=merged_path, scope="client", scope_id=portal_id)
